{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial currency reserve''' was the primary holding place for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] vast physical wealth. That wealth formed the most extensive store of valuable commodities in the whole [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Its exact location was a well-kept secret, and it was believed that several levels of security served to protect its precious contents.
